developer_description: Lead your fleet to glory in epic interstellar warfare.

reviews.text: Best turn-based tactics I've played in years. Every mission feels like a puzzle and the squad customization is deep. Soundtrack is amazing too.
Great gameplay but the campaign crashed twice on mission 7. Lost an hour of progress. Devs patched it quickly though.
Too hard and the tutorial explains nothing. Spent 2 hours just figuring out action points. Refunded.
Reminds me of XCOM but with better ship building. 60 hours in and still finding new strategies.
Graphics are okay, nothing special, but the AI opponents are smart and make you think. Worth the price on sale.
Story is forgettable and the voice acting is wooden. Gameplay loop gets repetitive after 20 hours.
Co-op skirmish with a friend is a blast. Wish there were more maps.
Runs smooth on my old laptop, no frame drops. Great value for 25 euros.
